title: iPad Side Drawer Touch-Layer Fix
notes: Restores the Edit Holes right-side drawer on iPad in landscape while retaining the bottom sheet in portrait.
Stabilizes the fixed drawer as an isolated WebKit compositor and hit-test surface.
Adds a touch-routing safety layer so visible drawer buttons remain tappable at their displayed positions after hole-selection redraws.
Keeps iOS momentum scrolling disabled and removes the canvas resize animation on touch devices.
Preserves the m40.6 responsive laptop drawer and integrated pattern workflow.
Preserves role-based access, cloud rules compatibility, permanent document identity, header preservation, rotation, and conflict safeguards.
